Excellent! I've successfully implemented weekly subscription support for subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

### 1. **Core Functionality (src/cycles.js)**
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` constant
- Implemented `monthlyCents()` to calculate weekly plans: `price × 52 ÷ 12`, rounded to nearest cent
- Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly subscriptions by adding 7 days at a time

### 2. **CLI (bin/subtrack.js)**
- Updated usage to show `--every month|year|week`
- Added "week"/"weekly" to the `EVERY` mapping
- Updated error message for unsupported cycle types
- Added weekly plans to `SHARE_PER_MONTH` calculation for the `total` command

### 3. **Export (src/export.js)**
- Added weekly cycle to MONTHS calculation for CSV exports

### 4. **Bug Fix (src/renewals.js)**
- Fixed sorting to use actual dates instead of short labels, which was sorting incorrectly across month boundaries

### 5. **Tests (test/cycles.test.js & test/cli.test.js)**
- Added 5 new tests for weekly subscriptions
- Verified correct monthly cost calculation
- Verified next charge calculation for weekly plans
- Verified CLI integration

## Feature Verification

The implementation now supports:
- ✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week`
- ✅ Weekly plans cost their price × 52 ÷ 12 per month (€12/week = €52/month)
- ✅ Weekly plans charge every 7 days from their first charge
- ✅ `subtrack renewals` lists weekly plans correctly with all other plans
- ✅ All commands work: list, total, renewals, export

All 39 tests pass successfully!
